description.summary: Baseline Basic RAG: plain vector search with no query rewriting or reranking, used to benchmark local embedding models against each other.
description.how_it_works: During indexing we build one document per entity (patient, doctor, department), split each into fixed-size character chunks, and embed them. When a question comes in, we embed it, retrieve the top-k most similar chunks, and hand them to the chat model to answer. There is no query rewriting and no reranking — this is the simplest pipeline and the baseline every later run tries to improve on.
